prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” dentist — the right provider depends on your case (simple single implant vs full-arch reconstruction), budget, comfort with sedation, and whether you want one clinician to handle placement and restoration or a team approach. For dental implants you generally want a specialist (oral & maxillofacial surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist) with substantial implant experience.

How to find the best provider in Columbus, OH
- Prefer specialists: look for a board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeon (ABOMS), a periodontist (AAP membership), or a prosthodontist (ACP membership) if complex restorative work is needed.  
- Volume & experience: ask how many implants they place per year and experience with your specific case (bone grafts, sinus lifts, immediate/“same-day” implants, All‑on‑4, etc.).  
- Imaging & technology: confirm they use CBCT (3D imaging) and offer guided implant placement when appropriate.  
- Restorative coordination: find out who will do the crown/bridge/prosthesis — the surgeon may place the implant but a restorative dentist or prosthodontist should complete the final tooth. Seamless coordination matters.  
- Implant brands & warranties: reputable systems (Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, Dentsply Sirona, etc.) and any guarantees or follow-up policies.  
- Patient results & reviews: before/after photos, patient testimonials, complication rates, and online reviews (Google, Healthgrades, Yelp).  
- Comfort & sedation options: IV sedation, oral sedation, or nitrous oxide if you’re anxious.  
- Cost & financing: get a written estimate with separate line items for surgery, grafting, and restoration.

Useful directories and resources
- American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons (AAOMS) directory  
- American Academy of Periodontology (AAP) find-a-periodontist  
- American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID) directory  
- ADA Find-a-Dentist and local Columbus dental society listings  
- Read Google/Healthgrades/Yelp reviews and look for before/after photos

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Are you board‑certified? How many implants do you place per year?  
- Who will do my restoration (crown/bridge/denture)? Do you collaborate with a prosthodontist?  
- Which implant system do you use and why?  
- Do you use CBCT and guided surgery?  
- What is the timeline, likely additional procedures (grafts, sinus lift) and total cost?  
- What are the risks and your complication/success rates? Can I see before/after photos and speak with past patients?

If you’d like, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you have any insurance or preferences (e.g., sedation, same-day teeth), and I can help narrow options and list well-reviewed specialists in Columbus for you to consider.
